Puncak pertemuan pemimpin ekonomi Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) resmi dimulai di Shenzhen, China, pada 18–19 November 2026. Berita dari **CNBC** (18 November 2026, [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/18/apec-trump-xi-putin-shenzhen.html](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/18/apec-trump-xi-putin-shenzhen.html)) menyoroti pertemuan bilateral penting antara Presiden AS Donald Trump dan Presiden China Xi Jinping di sela-sela KTT APEC, di mana fokus utama diarahkan pada implementasi perjanjian perdagangan dan manajemen risiko di tengah ketegangan teknologi chip AI.

> "If there is room for genuine U.S.-China cooperation this week, it's on managing risk rather than sharing advantage."
